summary: P4 product architecture is approved with zero blocking findings. The reviewed candidate fixes mode=shadow and active_product_effect=none at the lifecycle, store and runtime boundaries; keeps a separate CandidateLedger with no live DecisionTrace authority; lets the Hunter select only system-generated bounded identifiers through a recursively checked candidate-blind projection; and attaches only shadow references to the existing stable terminal event. Fast and alert-verify paths are read-only, active_discovery remains the stable product path, no user authority switch exists, and no P4 edge reaches live validation, promotion, Finding-root, reports or TerminalAuthority.

non_blocking_findings.title: Internal and projected localized-desert names are intentionally asymmetric
non_blocking_findings.evidence: planner.py records localized_candidate_desert while blind.py projects localized_signal_desert so the prohibited token cannot reach the model; the mapping is currently localized to blind.py.
non_blocking_findings.recommendation: Keep an explicit mapping constant and focused regression assertion when the trigger registry next changes.

non_blocking_findings.title: Shadow proof-decision diagnostics expose counts but not reason-code distribution
non_blocking_findings.evidence: The independent shadow CandidateLedger intentionally has decision_trace_store=None; coverage_summary records aggregate counts while detailed proof decisions remain in the P4 CAS.
non_blocking_findings.recommendation: Before P5, consider a shadow-only reason-code histogram or equally isolated diagnostic log.

non_blocking_findings.title: force_unconfirmed is a critical P4 boundary but has limited inline explanation
non_blocking_findings.evidence: runtime.py passes force_unconfirmed=True when registering a Checker-confirmed hypothesis into the independent shadow ledger.
non_blocking_findings.recommendation: Document at the call site that the flag enforces the pre-P5 shadow boundary.

checks.name: candidate identity and clean worktree
checks.evidence: HEAD cc0e25f1fa34f0d9234f108a7d8fd22aa772ee58 and tree 71a63eb25fbf6d5c65f1294fa948caa88b64f026 matched the assigned target; the worktree was clean.

checks.name: shadow authority boundary
checks.evidence: lifecycle.py, store.py and runtime.py hard-code shadow/none; lifecycle and wheel gates forbid config toggles and live authority imports.

checks.name: independent shadow ledger
checks.evidence: runtime.py constructs a separate CandidateLedger with decision_trace_store=None, marks every issue shadow_only and force-unconfirmed, freezes it separately, and returns no live decision field.

checks.name: fast and alert read-only behavior
checks.evidence: The fast branch and AlertVerifier load only a validated frozen P4 identity and never instantiate the Hunter runtime or agent.

checks.name: bounded candidate-blind Hunter
checks.evidence: The allowlisted projection guards keys and scalar values after NFKC/casefold normalization and repeats the guard over serialized JSON; the terminal schema restricts offer, action, fact and evidence values to system-provided enums.

checks.name: single terminal event
checks.evidence: DecisionTrace adds P4 refs to the existing terminal policy input/event and preserves terminal deduplication; no P4 terminal-authority event is created.

checks.name: content-addressed storage and cache
checks.evidence: CAS writes are atomic and hash-verified; cache identity binds the unit, offers, P3 manifest, proof registry, prompt, model profile and dependency hashes.

checks.name: qualification and answer isolation
checks.evidence: The frozen artifact contains 120 neutral cases, zero safe and near-miss false registration, 100 percent contract resolution, three projects with replayable proof and a source/expected split not read by product runtime.

checks.name: package and forbidden dependency boundary
checks.evidence: The reviewed package contains the P4 schemas, prompt and qualification artifact and imports no Benchmark, truth, Scorer, reporting or live-validation authority module.

checks.name: recorded wheel and full gate result
checks.evidence: The read-only reviewer accepted the recorded exact-candidate results: 1961 passed, 7 skipped; wheel SHA-256 1be227391e4203170e98866fc17b44be6734681894f314de009a24653cc31074.

limitations: The three historical P0 benchmark aggregates are absent and were not represented as replayed.
The review was read-only and did not independently rebuild the wheel or rerun the full test suite.
The product-architecture role did not replace the independent proof-security review.
Qualification uses frozen neutral structural projects; real-project scale and performance remain P5/P6 concerns.
No Range truth, fixture or Scorer input was read and no benchmark was run.

It inspected the design, P4 contracts, product code, orchestration, qualification and gates without modifying files or reading Range truth/fixtures/Scorer inputs. Decision: approved with zero blocking findings.
